in_hebrew.name: Boris
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Bringer of glory
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Boris הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Bulgarian and Russian name Borisevich, meaning 'man of Boril' or 'man of glory'. Boris was the name of several early Christian rulers and saints, including Boris I of Bulgaria and Boris of Veliky Novgorod.
